column1: # NO_ORACLE_ANSWER (Lon 2026-10-11 16:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "Exclude any program in which we have no way to get output from an
# oracle, or in which we do not know the answer."; ceo CEO-1696, RULES.md FACT RULE A PROGRAM WITH NO ORACLE ANSWER IS EXCLUDED, NEVER DEBT):
# every program UNGRADABLE.tsv names -- the oracle refuses it, crashes, aborts, hangs or cannot run it, or answers differently on two runs -- leaves
# the denominator, named here with UNGRADABLE.tsv's own class and measurement verbatim; UNGRADABLE.tsv keeps the measurement (the coo 2026-10-14).

column3: UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: fpc -Miso itself fails to compile this ISO 7185 acceptance program: "Fatal: Syntax error, \"BEGIN\" expected but \"xor\" found" at line 48 col 4; the reference compiler rejects its own suite's fixture

UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: fpc 3.2.2 -Miso never finishes compiling this ISO 7185 acceptance program: ppcx64 spins at 100% CPU with no diagnostic (measured >300s; line 1 warning "Unsupported switch" is the only output). Bisected to line 77 `label 0, 3, 9999, 0004;` -- a three-line program declaring `label 0;` reproduces the spin under -Miso and -Mextendedpascal, while labels 1, 01, 0004 and 9999 compile; -Mfpc and -Mtp instead reject the program at line 114. ISO 7185 permits label 0, so the reference compiler cannot build its own suite's acceptance fixture (cfo 2026-09-07)

# success." · "You better fix your flawed measurement system for the test suites."; his ruling on the coo's question, "Tighten, else exclude"; ceo
# CEO-1865): a program whose expected answer a BROKEN ENGINE can produce -- a refusal with no line or ISO clause to check it against, or empty

# in its header, a marked line, an input that makes it print). Measured by util_false_green_census.sh: an engine that prints an error and exits 1
# earned all 417 graded rejection tests under the old refused-with-a-diagnostic verdict; the tightened verdict (test_pascal_pat_suite.sh) grades
# the 397 that carry a marked line or a cited clause and these are the rest.
